description.p: EDID Editor is an editor for EDID (Extended Display Identification Data) structures. It supports EDID v1.3+ base blocks and CTA-861 extension blocks, including the Data Block Collection (audio, video, vendor specific and other data blocks).
This is the GTK4/libadwaita port of wxEDID.
Initial GTK4/libadwaita port of the EDID/CTA-861 core parser.
